comment: Canonical #669 SKP<->GLB parity fixture. Single numeric authority shared by TS domain, Go domain and the SketchUp TestUp host smoke. Evolves the #668 edge-wireframe bracket (progress/host_smoke_668_mount_frame_geometry_evidence.json) into a closed triangulated solid suitable for GLB, keeping the proven dimensions, MountFrame, reference points and placement-chain constants unchanged. expectedWorldMm values are hand-derived contract constants (independent arithmetic documented in this file), never produced by the transform functions under test.

asset.name: bracket-glb-parity
asset.description: Asymmetric L-shaped stepped bracket, closed solid: bottom outline extruded in +Z. Distinct X/Y/Z extents, geometric origin different from the mounting point, non-collinear reference points.

glbRepresentation.producer: SketchUp host smoke writes this file through GraneteForSketchup::Assets::GlbWriter from the solid above; the committed bytes are the host-produced evidence and CI tests must load exactly these bytes.
glbRepresentation.assetToGlb: asset (x,y,z) mm Z-up -> glb (x, z, -y) m Y-up: glbX = x/1000, glbY = z/1000, glbZ = -y/1000
glbRepresentation.glbToAssetMm: glb (X,Y,Z) m Y-up -> asset (X, -Z, Y) mm Z-up: assetX = X*1000, assetY = -Z*1000, assetZ = Y*1000

handDerivation: T_norm = inverse(T_mountFrame): R_norm = R_mount^T has columns x=(0,-1,0), y=(1,0,0), z=(0,0,1); t_norm = -R_norm.(25,30,15) = (-30,25,-15). Effective member transform = T_member x T_norm: basis rows of R_member are (1,0,0),(0,0,-1),(0,1,0); R_eff = R_member.R_norm = [[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0]] with columns x=(0,0,-1), y=(1,0,0), z=(0,-1,0), det=+1; t_eff = (3,7,1) + R_member.(-30,25,-15) = (-27,22,26). P0=(17,23,11): R_eff.P0 = (23,-11,-17); +t_eff = (-4,11,9); +assembly = (11,61,109); +furniture = (1211,661,409). Same arithmetic gives P1 -> (1211,661,339) and P2 -> (1265,661,395). These world constants equal the #668 host-measured evidence (actualWorldMm), so SketchUp host, TS and Go all assert against the same independently derived numbers.
